Full interval fragment counts are within the preserved recovered inputs, not normalized expression or independent signal molecules.
Nested starts, alternative frames, repeated alignments and geometry aliases can reuse witnesses; do not add their counts.
Reference UTR ORFs are hypothetical translations; divergent continuation length is not the number of individually substituted residues.
PacBio base qualities are unavailable; initiation, RNA polarity, complete mature transcripts and translation remain unresolved.
Novel eight-mers are sequence comparisons, not HLA binding, antigen presentation or T-cell recognition predictions.
